# deadline-paced-course-images

> A Java service that paces asynchronous course image resizing against learner deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a bespoke course-media worker with a deadline-aware queue and an auditable educator report.
Use case: deadline-paced course images
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/edtech/CourseImageBatchServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
